key_terms: Distance Formula: Distance between P(x1, y1) and Q(x2, y2) is sqrt((x2 - x1)^2 + (y2 - y1)^2).
Distance of point P(x, y) from origin O(0,0) is sqrt(x^2 + y^2).
Section Formula (Internal division): Coordinates of P(x, y) dividing segment AB joining A(x1, y1) and B(x2, y2) in ratio m1:m2 are ((m1*x2 + m2*x1)/(m1+m2), (m1*y2 + m2*y1)/(m1+m2)).
Midpoint Formula: Special case of section formula with ratio 1:1, yielding ((x1 + x2)/2, (y1 + y2)/2).
Collinearity test: Points A, B, C are collinear if distance AB + BC = AC.
